svg.title: Awaken-HI: Ego Pre-training and Robot Fine-tuning
svg.desc: Awaken-HI architecture with egocentric pretraining on a towel-folding example and robot fine-tuning on a cart-picking example. The web version animates data flow, depth and robot action sequences, and shows demonstration footage and motion visualizations.

rect.data-label: Egocentric video of grey towel folding
Robot head camera video of picking a white item from the cart
Human whole-body motion from the towel-folding demonstration
